visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a stylized graphic of Batman in a dark, high-contrast action scene with floating debris. Large cyan text introduces the main topic against a black background. A small animated avatar of a male character appears in the top corner. (2) A transition brings up a bright white screen featuring a colorful poster of the Marvel Avengers, showcasing multiple heroes in a group pose. Large white text with a yellow '1' marks the first segment. (3) An illustration of a medieval knight with a red cape standing in a vast, orange-lit desert environment follows. Then, a 2D animated male character in a grey t-shirt appears against a dark background, looking thoughtful while holding sheets of paper. (4) A blue silhouette graphic appears, clutching its chest to illustrate internal emotional struggle while text overlays explain a concept. (5) The scene shifts to a comic book illustration of Batman flexing his muscles, followed by the narrator character gesturing towards the viewer. (6) Real video footage of Beyonce in a turtleneck during an interview is shown, followed by a dynamic concert clip of her performing on stage with bright lights and a large backing screen. (7) Comic art of Wonder Woman is introduced, leading into a series of animations depicting a woman vacuuming and caring for a child. This is punctuated by brief, intense clips of real women looking stressed or angry. (8) A comic frame of the Incredible Hulk is displayed, followed by a cinematic movie clip of the Hulk roaring and smashing into another character in a city setting. (9) The video concludes with the branded logo of the creator, featuring a circular character icon and social call-to-action buttons.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 維思維. [Slogan]: 以「英雄」命名的心理現象. [Variety]: 蝙蝠俠效應. (2) [Variety]: 1 英雄情結. (3) [Subtitle]: 英雄症候群. [Subtitle]: 拯救者症候群. (4) [Subtitle]: 是指某些人總是覺得自己必須拯救別人來證明自己的存在價值從而過度付出. (5) [Variety]: 2 蝙蝠俠效應. (6) [Subtitle]: 你試過嗎？想像自己是另一個人給自己換個角色帶入工作能增強自信和更有力量喔. (7) [Subtitle]: 就像碧昂絲在上台前緊張時會設定自己變成「莎莎・菲爾斯」進入更有力量和自信的表演模式. (8) [Variety]: 3 女超人症候群. (9) [Subtitle]: 和以前傳統社會要求的女性角色比起來現代女性被要求扮演多重角色不只要面對繁重家務和照顧孩子還要上班從而導致壓力和影響身心健康. (10) [Variety]: 4 綠巨人症候群. (11) [Subtitle]: 就像浩克一樣綠巨人症候群是指患者會反覆、突然的出現憤怒或衝動的攻擊性行為. A male narrator introduces the topic with a clear, enunciated studio-quality voice. A high-pitched 'ding' SFX punctuates the transition to the first hero point. (2) The interplay continues as a digital 'whoosh' sound marks the shift between psychological concepts. The narrator maintains a consistent, friendly, and informative tone with moderate pitch variability. The BGM levels dip slightly during detailed explanations. (3) During the Beyonce segment, her female voice provides a brief acoustic contrast with a natural conversational tone, accompanied by distant crowd cheering and rhythmic live performance audio. A percussive 'thud' SFX introduces the next segment. (4) The Hulk segment features a loud, guttural non-human vocal roar with high spectral energy, signaling intense action. The narrator returns with a calm, corrective tone to explain the clinical term. The video ends with a series of light, playful 'pop' and UI click sound effects.
